svg.aria-label: Mock-up of the cuscope Azure Workbook Overview tab: summary tiles, smoothed utilisation chart, top contributors and harvester health. Illustrative data.
svg.text: Read from the Capacity Metrics model by the cuscope harvester (outside Fabric). CU figures are CU-seconds; percentages are of the capacity's base budget.
Smoothed utilisation: background and interactive (reconstructed) vs the app. The red line is the throttling threshold. Drag across the chart to set the explain window.
Top contributors in the explain window
Harvester health (last 24 h). Errors should be 0.
